body.p: At any time, if you want to see the differences between the last commit and your current modifications, you can double-click a file from either the Unstaged files area or Staged files area, and the Compare Files window will appear and highlight the changes.

If the file has a conflict (has been modified both by you and another), Oxygen's 3-Way file comparison feature will show a comparison between the local change, the remote change, and the original base revision.
